Rainbow Six Vegas 2 came out in 2008 for the PS3, Xbox 360, and PC. The game was developed Ubisoft Montreal and publish by Ubisoft. I got the game for $10 on PS3 from Amazon. The game retails for $10 on average on all systems.

The story is a direct continuation from Rainbow Six Vegas 1 which ended on a cliff hanger. The game starts off in France a few years prior to the events of Vegas and then flashes forward to Vegas right when the terrorist start attacking Vegas. Overall the story it's self is okay, I didn't think it was as good as the first game.

Gameplay:

Gameplay is very similar to the first game still a FPS, you still use a team of three including yourself, you can use your teammates to flank or give suppression fire along with breaching and clearing rooms. Like the last game it's a primary cover fire game. some of the new add on's are you can now coordinate with you teammates to throw grenades and smoke bombs. However, your team A.I doesn't seem as smart as the first game your teammates tend to get stuck together a lot when you tell them move some where.

The game also went from being a tactical shooter to more of a Call of Duty style game. They added a sprint button, an experience point system and you have the exact same arsenal as the first game but you must do certain things to unlock the same weapons that you had full access too in the first game. There are also body armor upgrades in the game now but you either take armor or mobility. The game also offers a customization for your character's face and the uniform.

Overall I give the game a 7/10. It does have a big graphical upgrade compared to the first game, but it doesn't have a that Rainbow Six feel to it and change a lot of things in the game, mainly I didn't like how they made the game more of a Call of Duty knockoff. I haven't tried the multiplayer on PS3, but I hear the PC community is still pretty good with the game.
